owner_target: QWEN3.5-0.8B-class cognitive-process substrate for variable cognitive grid + persistent database + Claude Code, with semantic Hyperposition cross-cutting and model-specific J-Space claims evidence-bounded

coordination.relationship_to_existing_work: Adds a tokenizer-level discriminator after exact ABI materialization. It does not replace current full-cross/context-binding generators, byte render guards, semantic-ablation gates, cross-split leakage gates, Hyperposition labelers or derivation-bound gates.

current_strengths: model-visible prompt is byte-bound to private factorial state on the retained dynamic-binding path
measured nuisance factors include display order, polarity and higher-order conditional leakage
semantic-ablation challenger work exists at prompt/text level
final materialization is already required to bind the exact accepted 46-atom ABI inventory to a pinned tokenizer/checkpoint identity
cross-split prompt/content/family/semantic/atom/provenance overlap is already treated as fail-closed
repo_audit.remaining_gap: Current searched surfaces require tokenizer identity and token-count/position binding but do not expose a dedicated acceptance test showing that the exact token-ID/position representation of the final rendered pilot contains no target-predictive nuisance shortcut after semantic evidence is ablated.

external_method_inputs.source: Sekhsaria et al., LoRA Users Beware: A Few Spurious Tokens Can Manipulate Your Finetuned Model, arXiv:2506.11402, 2025
external_method_inputs.relevance: Reports that very small numbers of class-correlated tokens can become dominant shortcuts during PEFT. The exact PEFT result must not be generalized as a measured full-FT Qwen3.5 fact, but it raises the value of an explicit token-level shortcut falsifier.

external_method_inputs.source: Phan et al., Understanding and Mitigating Tokenization Bias in Language Models, arXiv:2406.16829, 2024
external_method_inputs.relevance: Shows tokenization itself can induce systematic bias, supporting explicit tokenizer-bound evaluation rather than assuming byte-level balance survives encoding.

external_method_inputs.source: Reddy et al., On Counterfactual Data Augmentation Under Confounding, arXiv:2305.18183, 2023
external_method_inputs.relevance: Supports counterfactual interventions on spurious/confounding features as a way to test and reduce non-causal associations.

external_method_inputs.source: Dwork et al., Generalization in Adaptive Data Analysis and Holdout Reuse, arXiv:1506.02629, 2015
external_method_inputs.relevance: Supports keeping the frozen holdout genuinely nonadaptive; a tokenizer-level gate must be preregistered before opening the first rendered holdout.

hypothesis: A dataset can pass byte-level rendering, marginal/factorial balancing and split-family checks yet still expose target-predictive nuisance information through tokenizer-specific token identity, token count or token position after final ABI materialization.
counterhypothesis: Exact byte-level full crossing plus pinned tokenizer identity is already sufficient, so token-level nuisance checks will add no discriminatory information.

cheapest_high_information_discriminator.name: TRIGGER2_TOKENIZER_LEVEL_SHORTCUT_GATE/v1
inputs: exact selected checkpoint/tokenizer artifact identity and hashes
exact token ID sequence and token offsets for every row
semantic-evidence span boundaries derived from the renderer, never inferred from target labels
required_checks: bind prompt bytes -> tokenizer identity -> token IDs/offsets deterministically and fail closed on mismatch

compute target-class and target-slot mutual information against tokenizer-level nuisance features including total token count, section token counts, symbol/codebook token IDs, separator/punctuation token IDs and model-visible token positions
perform semantic-evidence ablation before tokenization and run a nuisance-only exact-signature/decoder challenge on the resulting token-ID representation
require chance-level target prediction under the preregistered nuisance-only challenger within each eligible counterbalanced family, not merely zero marginal MI
require every eligible tokenizer-level nuisance signature to preserve all three semantic target classes and all three target slots where the task design says they should remain possible

run matched semantics-preserving nuisance interventions that alter serialization/tokenization surface while holding the formal semantic world and computed target fixed; target labels must remain invariant
reject any token, token-count bucket, position bucket or joint tokenizer-level signature that becomes a high-accuracy target proxy on TRAIN/VALIDATION
freeze the gate, thresholds, tokenizer identity and holdout manifest before opening the first frozen holdout
repeat the same gate on final serialized bytes after every materialization transform; source-template PASS does not transfer automatically
negative_controls: inject one target-correlated nuisance token outside semantic evidence and require rejection
inject target-correlated whitespace/punctuation that changes tokenization and require rejection
alter a codebook atom so private metadata remains balanced but token count/position correlates with target and require rejection
change tokenizer/checkpoint identity without regenerating the token receipt and require rejection
reuse a frozen holdout to choose nuisance features or thresholds and classify the holdout as contaminated
cheapest_high_information_discriminator.positive_control: A deliberately counterbalanced rendered fixture with identical formal semantics/targets and token-level nuisance support across the complete S3/polarity/order family should pass the gate without minting model or training credit.

training_policy_delta.policy: Do not promote the first 46-atom rendered pilot to training-eligible merely because byte/factor/split gates pass. Add tokenizer-level shortcut rejection as a preregistered admission condition.

artifact_lifecycle.action: do not supersede from this PR-local method delta

artifact_lifecycle.reason: existing higher-order nuisance leakage remains fatal
byte-level/factorial evidence does not yet establish tokenizer-level nuisance independence
immutable event digest, discriminator admissibility/execution/coverage, typed GRF evidence and exact-current execution blockers are orthogonal and remain open

next_exact_action: When the exact accepted 46-atom ABI manifest and pinned selected-checkpoint tokenizer are available, implement this gate against the final rendered pilot bytes and token IDs before any training admission; until then retain as METHOD_INPUT and generate no new positive training volume.
